title: Prove a complete terminal-band QQ16 cost exclusion
body:
## Result and construction decision

Frozen #4166 QQ16 D costs **strictly more reads, writes and unit moves** than original-arithmetic B* on a nonempty, explicitly admitted **terminal-child domain**. This closes a complete signed comparison beyond #4172; it is not another native-component ratio or ledger with unexplained E1/E8/Delta_N prices.

The conclusion is scoped. Keep actual RootPlan fast entry, post-remainder e=73 lambda with d<=e^1000, the genuine C8 terminal predicate `8 lambda<73 OR (8 lambda)^1000<d`, physical H_b>=L^4, complete packet v>=2685, the certified positive-slope column threshold, and compatible admitted q/profile/program/capacity choices. Original source/numerical/hosting/stock/long-record premises remain. Forty exact production-descriptor certificates at p=2^8500 establish lambda=5..44 in this domain. Their enormous payloads were not executed.

**Stop expanding the fixed recovery in this proved band.** No verdict is claimed for nonterminal C8 calls, changed source-compatible demands/schedules, arbitrary compiled-control tariffs, total historical backing, all-node suppliers or kappa.

## What resolves the remaining prices

The actual source occurrence partition removes32 centre-wrapper monomials,16 rank-eight children,8 private copies and6 unit subtracts. The six subtracts match new identical-literal calls at the same full geometry. Monomials split at literal source call sites into equal setup/phase/return bases and exact completed gate atoms. Inverse reverses the word; it does not change a gate selector. #4172 supplies successful-payload/closed-history equality only at matching full geometry.

The736 old wrapper gates inject into7150 fixed new gates except4 Gamma add(6,8) and Gamma add(8,6). A new quantified finite-group result closes those deficits: every fixed9x9 head has more than half its independent-bit mass in the complete O(73,2) cover, using64-coordinate tails and an explicit characteristic-vector exclusion. Leading-block events force each literal gate with frequency greater than Gamma/32. The736 paid owner words supply more than23 Gamma of each. Identity-owner witnesses are not extrapolated and no axis-cost invariance is assumed.

The complete terminal original C call, including descriptor/shape work, the paid capped-power cutoff, all coefficient axes, return, disposal and borrowed heads, has componentwise bound

    E_w <= 2^32(w+1)[v+(G_s+1)L^4] <= 2^33(w+1)v,
    G_s=v/(2H_b).

There are exactly zero descendants on this source branch. Added E1 calls have this same derived bound and are conservatively dropped as positive work in the exclusion. All removed16 E8 calls use an UPPER bound. Eight copies and sixteen B external shells have separate source-derived upper debits; A's embedded parking is never used as avoided baseline work.

After matching the original two core bank cycles, actual candidate-only gathers and disjoint scatter appends give

    (R,W,M) >= (2,1,2)(281593/816) Gamma B_bank,
    B_bank=14336 Gamma v; service_bank=B_bank/32.

This is a literal source-action lower bound, not a diagnostic volume subtraction. Every other acquisition/compiler/service/scalar/map/publication/disposal/fence/setup term is matched, debited on the correct side, or retained nonnegative. Exchange-internal negations are not added twice.

## Complete fair-baseline certificate

Let a=(281593/816)*14336 Gamma and

    C(lambda)=16*2^33(8lambda+1)+8*2^22+16*2^26.
    s=(2a+5*510662-C, a+2*510662-C, 2a+4*510662-C).
    h=(12*510646+2*510662, 4*510646, 12*510646+2*510662).

The entire root comparison satisfies, componentwise:

    (T_D-T_B*)_i >= Gamma v s_i + Gamma h_i - 66496 > 0.

All510646 Gamma retained bodies cancel under #4172, including6972 changed-core and493097 later calls. Their14,298,088 Gamma header actions remain. B*'s established adoption saving is credited exactly once; frozen D gets no D* adjustment. The703-write original-backend potential cancels once globally. The66496 total B-controller startup/retirement upper is pessimistically subtracted in EACH coordinate.

The last positive column integer is derived explicitly, has2610 bits, and passes an endpoint/next-integer check. It is a sufficient bound threshold, not a claim every geometry below it is reachable. For arbitrary positive action weights, exclusion holds in this source currency. Full compiled-step exclusion additionally requires signed control difference at least minus the weighted lower bound. Fixed inventories remain B/B*:678+M(q)+1023, D:conservative678+3M(q)+2^20; historical per-role backing is separate and erasure does not reclaim it.

Default fresh evidence includes17 exact countdown calibrations,7 complete selected C leaf executions,1 explicitly reduced-binding complete cutoff execution,3 encoded cutoff kernels,12 phase cases,3 complete bank cycles, literal O73 gate witnesses, full occurrence/later/service census,40 exact RootPlan geometries and independent signed/counting/schema controls. Fresh ordinary/optimised primary and six source/export/typed-receipt boundary groups passed. The full registered launcher passed, with six boundary groups in95.511seconds. Width>=73 alone does not certify recursion. No additional decoder search is justified by this scoped result. Selected kappa is unchanged.

Committed scientific export replays both PASS: ordinary50.928s, optimised58.403s, empty stderr, Git absent, executable search path unavailable, and unchanged bytes/modes/mtimes/inodes. These reran all default physical calibrations from the exact committed108-file export plus manifest; check-only transport is separate.
